title: step
description: Fact row: one step inside a rollout — the PERFORMANCE progression. This is the y-axis of a performance-vs-compute plot; pair (evals_used, best_so_far) with the rollout's compute for the x-axis.

kind.description: seed = refunded baseline; probe = subsampled off-budget, NOT comparable to a full eval and never updates best; note = audit text, not a measurement

counts_against_budget.description: false for seed, probe, note — precomputed so readers need no task semantics

is_measurement.description: false for note rows, whose combined_score is filler

evals_used.description: cumulative budgeted evaluations AFTER this step; the natural inner-search x-axis

combined_score.description: this step's score, combined scale; null for note rows

best_so_far.description: monotone max over budgeted measurements up to and including this step; the y-axis

wall_s.description: per-step sandbox wall time; recovers probe cost, which the rollout ledger omits
